Parity report

Legacy Struts app versus extracted services. Every verdict is PASS or CHANGED (with its CHG record); anything else is FAIL. Generated by make parity; source of truth parity/report.md and report.json.

Rule coverage as text

Each rule version of each spec and the scenarios that exercise it. A rule with no scenario is listed with “none”.

Marks

Automated the service answer equalled the legacy answer on every compared item; no human judgement is part of the verdict. Reviewer the verdict also rests on a recorded human decision: an approved CHG record, or the ADR rule that a 5xx answers the legacy error.jsp forward (which the legacy app sends with status 200). The decision is named on the row.
